# Built by Josh Studio — Free Browser Tools (Tynkr Tools & Co)

> Free, ad-free, local-first personal finance and small-business web calculators running directly in your browser with zero accounts and zero server uploads.

## About & Authority

- **Legal entity**: Built by Josh Studio LLC, a Kansas limited liability company (Kansas Business ID 10076138), formed in 2026; the studio began in 2025.
- **Founder**: Josh — solo developer, designer, and support contact (`support@builtbyjoshstudio.com`, answered directly by the founder).
- **Studio network (five canonical sites)**:
  - **Money & Business Calculators (this site)**: https://tools.builtbyjoshstudio.com/money/ · Directory: https://tools.builtbyjoshstudio.com/
  - **Studio Home, Notion Templates, Workbooks, Planners & Zodiac Art**: https://builtbyjoshstudio.com/ (index: https://builtbyjoshstudio.com/llms.txt)
  - **Tynkr Windows Desktop Apps**: https://tynkr.builtbyjoshstudio.com/ (index: https://tynkr.builtbyjoshstudio.com/llms.txt)
  - **Cooking, Recipes, Cookbook, Videos & Kitchen Calculators**: https://cooking.builtbyjoshstudio.com/ (tools: https://cooking.builtbyjoshstudio.com/tools/, index: https://cooking.builtbyjoshstudio.com/llms.txt)

## Tynkr Tools & Co — Windows Desktop Apps (Coming Soon)

Privacy-first, local-first Windows software where user data stays on disk (no cloud, no accounts, no subscriptions; pay-once model via Microsoft Store): https://tynkr.builtbyjoshstudio.com/

- [Tynkr Ledger — Personal Finance OS](https://tynkr.builtbyjoshstudio.com/ledger/): Budgeting, transactions, bills, debt payoff, and net worth on your own disk.
- [Tynkr Vault — Second Brain OS](https://tynkr.builtbyjoshstudio.com/vault/): Local-first Markdown notes, tasks, and fast fuzzy search.
- [Tynkr Hearth — Homebuyer OS](https://tynkr.builtbyjoshstudio.com/hearth/): Mortgage math, down payment saving, cash-to-close estimates, roadmap, and document checklist.
- [Tynkr Forge — Small Business OS](https://tynkr.builtbyjoshstudio.com/forge/): Client CRM, invoicing, purchase orders, contracts, expenses, and proposals.
- [Tynkr Inkpress — Book Formatting](https://tynkr.builtbyjoshstudio.com/inkpress/): Turn a manuscript into an EPUB 3 ebook, KDP print PDF, and author-site web page on Windows — no cloud, no accounts, no subscriptions.

## Beyond the Tools

- [Built by Josh Studio](https://builtbyjoshstudio.com/): Notion Creator OS templates ($19.99 / $68.99 stack), 23-tab Ultimate Budget & 15-tab Home Buying Workbooks ($22.99 Excel + Google Sheets), Guided Series print planners, free Lite editions, and zodiac digital art bundles.
- [Josh & Jordan's Kitchen & Nước Mắm Cookbook](https://cooking.builtbyjoshstudio.com/): *Nước Mắm: Simple Vietnamese Home Cooking* ($3.49 direct digital / $7.99 paperback) alongside no-talking videos filmed as tight method cuts and minimally cut full-process sessions at normal speed.
- [J.S. Warden Writing & Interactive Fiction](https://writing.builtbyjoshstudio.com/): *Overlayed Echoes*, *Ebonspire Chronicles*, companion dispatches, and tabletop utilities.
- [Little Acre Learning](https://littleacrelearning.com/): Children's books and printables — a separate brand of Built by Josh Studio LLC.
